from solution import num_comm_div


def test_issue_example_2_4():
    """Issue example requires num_comm_div(2, 4) == 2."""
    assert num_comm_div(2, 4) == 2  # common divisors {1, 2} -> count 2


def test_issue_coprime_pair():
    """Pair with only divisor 1 in common has count 1."""
    assert num_comm_div(5, 7) == 1  # divisors 5:{1,5} 7:{1,7} common {1} -> 1


def test_issue_identical_numbers():
    """Identical inputs share all divisors of that number."""
    assert num_comm_div(6, 6) == 4  # divisors of 6 are 1,2,3,6 -> count 4


def test_issue_one_divides_other():
    """When one number divides the other count divisors of smaller."""
    assert num_comm_div(3, 9) == 2  # common {1,3} -> count 2


def test_issue_pair_12_18():
    """Common divisors of 12 and 18 are four in number."""
    assert num_comm_div(12, 18) == 4  # gcd 6 divisors 1,2,3,6 -> count 4


def test_issue_pair_8_12():
    """Common divisors of 8 and 12 are three in number."""
    assert num_comm_div(8, 12) == 3  # common {1,2,4} -> count 3


def test_issue_one_with_other():
    """One shares only divisor 1 with any other number."""
    assert num_comm_div(1, 10) == 1  # divisors 1:{1} 10:{1,2,5,10} common {1} -> 1


def test_issue_swapped_arguments():
    """Order of the pair does not change the divisor count."""
    assert num_comm_div(4, 2) == 2  # same common set {1,2} as (2,4) -> count 2


def test_issue_identical_squares():
    """Identical square inputs share all divisors of that square."""
    assert num_comm_div(9, 9) == 3  # divisors of 9 are 1,3,9 -> count 3


def test_contract_returns_int():
    """Public interface implies num_comm_div returns a number."""
    assert isinstance(num_comm_div(6, 6), int)  # expected type int, e.g. 4 -> int


def test_contract_accepts_two_arguments():
    """Public interface defines num_comm_div(x, y) with two parameters."""
    import inspect
    assert len(inspect.signature(num_comm_div).parameters) == 2  # params (x,y) -> count 2
